items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, we were saying about 'Flatfoot Floogie' that 'Flatfoot Floogie' may have been kind of a predictor of some of the things Louie Jordan did...

ctx.x: *Native of Indonesia (Dutch East Indies) where he edited a magazine, Swing, during 1937-38 before emigrating to England, then America, 1939.

Yeah, we were saying about "Flatfoot Floogie" that "Flatfoot Floogie" may have been kind of a predictor of some of the things Louie Jordan did, some of the things that eventually evolved into rhythm and blues.
